newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Still talking about telecoms deal-S.Lanka's PERC.
newsitem.headline: Still talking about telecoms deal-S.Lanka's PERC.

text.p: No decision has yet been made on the sale of a 35 percent stake in state-owned international telephone monopoly Sri Lanka Telecom, an official of the Public Enterprise Reform Commission (PERC) said on Thursday.
The official was responding to a Reuters query that Japan's Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Company (NTT) would be awarded the stake and management of the company for $225 million.
Industry sources told Reuters details of the deal were expected to be announced in early August.
But the official at PERC, the government arm overseeing privatisation, told Reuters it would take a few more weeks to settle the sell-off.
Officials at Sri Lanka Telecom were unavailable for immediate comment.
NTT and France Telecom were both shortlisted for the final round of bidding for Sri Lanka Telecom.
